lang.title: Interface language
win.widget: Desktop widget: pick effects and switch them on/off, stays after reboot
dev.out: Where to send the processed voice
dev.monitorTip: Hear your processed voice in the headphones
dev.speakerTip: Your own voice. Effects with a fixed pitch shift (demon, giant, chipmunk…) adjust to it so they sound as intended. Neutral — as designed.
hk.title: Hotkeys
hk.note: They work in any program and in games. Pressing the shortcut of the active effect again turns it off. Click a shortcut, then press a key, a combination or a middle/side mouse button (Esc — cancel, Delete — remove). Next to it choose 1×, 2×, 3× or Hold — the effect stays on while the key is held.
hk.modeTitle: How to press: once, twice, three times, or hold (the effect is on only while held)
hk.busy: This shortcut is taken by another program — choose another one
hk.press: press a key or a mouse button…
hk.shiftLinux: Shift+digit does not work on Linux
osd.title: On-screen overlay
osd.toast: Show the effect when a hotkey is pressed
osd.note: On top of all windows, never takes focus or the mouse — it does not disturb games. The bar appears when the effect has a fade-in or fade-out and disappears at the peak. Over games in exclusive full-screen mode the system does not show hints — switching still works.
lane.amountTip: How far from the normal sound to the effect — all effect settings at once
lane.gateTip: Noise gate threshold, dB: quieter than this is silence (pauses without noise). All the way left — off
lane.qualityTip: Quality — cleaner sound and a margin against clicks (~40 ms delay); fast — ~20 ms delay, for games
ins.rampInTip: How long the voice takes to morph from normal into this effect (or from another effect)
ins.rampOutTip: How long the effect takes to fade away when turned off
pv.title: Test on a recording
pv.desc: Record a few seconds of your voice and listen to it through this effect while moving the knobs.
pv.playing: Playing the recording ({s} s) — you can move the knobs
pv.ready: Recording ready — press “Listen” again or pick another effect
info.target: Your voice ≈ {avg} Hz → target {t} Hz: adapts to any speaker
info.targetWait: Target — {t} Hz. Say something — the voice adapts to the speaker
widget.unpin: Remove the widget (it will no longer start with the system)
hint.micOk:
In Discord / Telegram / Zoom choose the microphone {mic}.
Effect on/off — {key}.
hint.noCable: To send the processed voice to Discord or games, install the free VB-Audio Virtual Cable (run the installer as administrator). HoloVoice picks it up by itself — then choose the microphone CABLE Output in your call app. Meanwhile turn on Hear myself (with headphones) to try the effects.
hint.routeFail: Could not create the virtual microphone: {err}. The voice goes to “{out}”.
hint.local: The voice goes to “{out}” — this is a listening test, it will not reach the call.
hint.sysOn: Everything playing on the computer (videos, the other person in a call) goes through the effect. On/off — {key}. When turned off, the sound goes back to normal.
hint.sysOff: Off — computer sound plays as usual. Turn it on to apply an effect to videos and the other person.
upd.noRemote: The git repository is not connected yet (no remote)
upd.dirty: The folder has uncommitted changes — update skipped
upd.noAuto: This build has no auto-update — install the version from GitHub Releases
ins.saveHint: Save the current settings as a new effect — it appears in “My effects”, in the widget and in hotkeys.
holo.title: HOLO ecosystem
neural.loading: Loading the voice model on the graphics card…
neural.error: Neural voice unavailable: {err}. The regular voice works meanwhile.
neural.off: Starts when the effect is on.
neural.unavailable: Neural voices need the GPU mode installed (NVIDIA). The regular voice works meanwhile.
hint.noVirtual: The voice isn’t sent anywhere yet — no virtual microphone. Turn on Hear myself (with headphones) to try the effects.
tray.notice: HoloVoice keeps working in the background — the effects stay on. Open it or quit from the tray icon.
speaker.title: Your voice
hk.altgr: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on Windows — use Alt+Shift or F-keys
menu.diagDone: Diagnostics copied — paste it into your message
setup.title: Setup guide
setup.intro: Four steps — each one turns green by itself when it works.
setup.micSay: Say something — the bar should move. Microphone: {mic} (change it in the “My voice” card).
setup.virtOk: Ready: {dev} — the processed voice goes there.
setup.virtWin:
Windows needs the free VB-Audio Virtual Cable to pass your processed voice to other apps:
  1. Download it and unpack the archive.
  2. Right-click VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe → Run as administrator → Install Driver.
  3. Restart the computer if it asks. HoloVoice notices the cable by itself.
setup.virtLinux: HoloVoice could not create its virtual microphone. Check that PipeWire (pipewire-pulse) or PulseAudio and the pactl tool are installed, then restart HoloVoice.
setup.app: In the app’s voice settings choose the microphone {mic}. Turn off its noise suppression / Krisp and echo cancellation — they fight the effects.
setup.try: Put on headphones and turn on Hear myself, then click a voice. More voices are in the catalog.
setup.voiceGuess: Your voice sounds around {hz} Hz — “{v}”. Effects tune themselves to it.
err.micDenied: The microphone is blocked by the system’s privacy settings — allow desktop apps to use the microphone.
err.micBusy: The microphone is busy — another program holds it exclusively, or the driver stopped. Close that program or pick another microphone; HoloVoice retries by itself.
err.micNone: No microphone found. Connect one — HoloVoice picks it up by itself.
upd.noNpm: Can’t update this copy: npm isn’t available here. Run “git pull && npm ci && npm run build:renderer” in its folder.
upd.offline: No connection to the update server — check the internet and try again.
upd.notReady: A new version is still being published — try again in a few minutes.
upd.limit: The update server asks to wait a little — try again later.
cat.fav: Add to favorites — shown first; next/previous hotkeys walk through favorites
hk.wayland: You are on Wayland: apps can’t catch global keys here, so these shortcuts work only while a HoloVoice window is focused. Add system shortcuts (Settings → Keyboard → Custom shortcuts) with commands like holovoice --toggle mic, holovoice --effect mic:demon, holovoice --next mic.
setup.menuAdd: Add HoloVoice to the applications menu
setup.menuDone: Added — HoloVoice is in the applications menu, and the holovoice command works in the terminal
